output_text: Guides AI agents contributing to `umami-kotlin`. `umami-kotlin` is a Kotlin Multiplatform library wrapping the Umami web analytics REST API, aiming for type-safe, asynchronous, easy-to-use Kotlin across Android/iOS/JVM. Modules: `:umami` (core), `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`. `:umami` packages: `api` (Umami REST comms), `core` (HTTP client + event queue), `domain` (data models/value objects like `Hostname`, `Ip`). Networking: Ktor for all HTTP; multiplatform via different engines per target (e.g., `OkHttp` for Android/JVM, `Darwin` for iOS). Async: Kotlinx Coroutines (esp. event queue). Serialization: Kotlinx Serialization. Time: `kotlin.time.Instant`. Logging: Kermit. Testing: Kotest; all new tests should use Kotest matchers (e.g., `shouldBe`) instead of `kotlin.test` assertions. Mocks: Mokkery. Patterns: Builder Pattern (`UmamiOptionsBuilder`), Facade Pattern (main `Umami`), Producer-Consumer Pattern (Kotlin `Channel` queue + background coroutine sending to Umami API). Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`. B
